# Delilah Brao

> Official website of Delilah Brao — indie-pop singer-songwriter from Boston,
> Massachusetts, based in Los Angeles. New single "Away with words" (2026).
> Debut album due 2027.

MusicAlbum JSON-LD on each /music/ page; FAQPage JSON-LD on /faq/.
